p.d: Little Hakka tells a story about children and nature. During their thrilling rescue mission, the children accidentally uncover a thousand-year-old secret connecting their Hakka ancestors with the animals of the forest.

THE SERIES FEATURES ASH'S ADVENTURES WITH HIS FRIEND, PIKACHU, AS THEY EXPLORE DIFFERENT POKEMON AREAS. THEY MEET NEW POKEMON TRAINERS, CHALLENGE GYM LEADERS, AND FACE TEAM ROCKET WHO ARE ALWAYS OUT TO STEAL POKEMON. ONE OF THE MAIN FOCUSES OF POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS IS THE EXPLORATION OF THE VAST WORLD OF POKEMON. ASH AND HIS FRIENDS AIM TO ATTEND THE WORLD CORONATION SERIES, A GREAT COMPETITION WHERE THEY TRY TO BECOME THE CHAMPIONSHIP OF POKEMON MASTER. ALONG THEIR JOURNEY, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, FACE NEW CHALLENGES, AND LEARN MORE ABOUT THE WORLD OF POKEMON. THE SERIES ALSO EXPLORES THE DYNAMICS BETWEEN ASH, PIKACHU, AND OTHER CHARACTERS THEY MEET ON THEIR ADVENTURES. THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.
